articles.title: Spain Pitches Incentives, Crews and a 500 Million-Strong Spanish-Speaking Market to India at WAVES Film Bazaar
articles.summary: Spain, the Country of Honor at this year’s International Film Festival of India (IFFI), made its case to Indian filmmakers at WAVES Film Bazaar in Goa, laying out its incentives, locations and crews and pushing for closer co-production ties.
body: “For us, co-production is a key instrument,” said Camilo Vázquez, deputy director of the Institute of Cinematography and Audiovisual Arts (ICAA), the film agency of Spain’s Ministry of Culture. He pointed to better financing, exchanges between technical and artistic teams, and stories that could connect with audiences in both countries, and described the timing as particularly favorable for India-Spain partnerships.

For Indian producers weighing Spain as a filming destination, the offer extends beyond its locations. Usha Jadhav, a National Award-winning actor and producer with Spanish company ACortes Films, highlighted the country’s track record with international productions, its range of landscapes and architecture, and skilled crews used to working on both big-budget and independent films. She also cited eight-hour shifts and quieter shooting environments as practical advantages, particularly for sync-sound productions.
Jadhav said the relationship should not be limited to service work, and made a case for collaborations that bring creative teams together across borders.

articles.title: China Box Office: ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ Opens at No. 1 in Quiet Frame
articles.summary: Lionsgate Films’ dystopian prequel “The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping” debuted atop the mainland China box office during the Nov. 20–22 weekend, collecting RMB39.3 million ($5.9 million) over its three-day opening frame, according to data from Artisan Gateway.
body: Constantin Film and Sony Pictures’ horror reboot “ Resident Evil ” placed third, taking in $1.7 million in its seventh weekend to lift its cumulative gross to $83 million since rolling out on Oct. 5.

Zhijiang Film Media’s suspense thriller “Love Test” debuted in fourth position, pulling in $1.1 million across its two-day opening frame following a Nov. 21 release. Directed by Hou Xiaoyao from a script co-written with Xu Xiaohu and executive produced by Lu Yang and Wang Hongwei, the Chinese remake of the 2011 Colombian-Spanish thriller “The Hidden Face” stars Feng Shaofeng, Chen Yusi, and Li Meng. The narrative follows a concert pianist whose girlfriend stages her own disappearance to test his fidelity, only for his new love interest to move into his mountain villa and uncover unsettling clues behind the vanishing.

articles.title: Hailee Steinfeld Confirms ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Return as Kate Bishop
articles.summary: Hailee Steinfeld will return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe as Kate Bishop in the forthcoming “Avengers: Doomsday.” Marvel Studios and Disney Animation announced the news Sunday with an Instagram post featuring Steinfeld.
body: “Catch Hailee Steinfeld in Disney’s ‘Hexed’ before she returns in ‘Avengers: Doomsday,'” read the caption.

Steinfeld previously appeared as Bishop in the 2021 Disney+ series “Hawkeye” and in 2023’s “The Marvels.” In “Hawkeye,” the “Sinners” actress shared the screen with Jeremy Renner’s superhero, while she appeared briefly in a post-credits scene alongside Brie Larson, Teyonah Parris, Iman Vellani and more for “The Marvels.”

“It’s really a privilege to be able to play a character that could in any way possibly inspire anyone,” Steinfeld previously told Variety about embodying the beloved comic character. “Kate Bishop is a character that I would have loved to have had growing up — somebody who is completely ambitious, driven and disciplined, and takes it upon herself to do whatever it is she has to do to achieve her goals.”

articles.title: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
articles.summary: In a statement to Italian media, his family remember him as "the greatest jeweller of our time".
body: Italian jeweller Paolo Bulgari, who helped turn his family's business into a global luxury brand, has died in Rome aged age 89.
Paolo Bulgari was Chairman of the Bvlgari Group since 1984 and its jewellery pieces have adorned Hollywood stars and royalty including Diana, Princess of Wales.
The company Bvlgari posted an online tribute to the "true creative soul", whose work would "continue to inspire generations to come".
The firm, Bulgari, was set up by his grandfather, Greek silversmith Sotirios Voulgaris, in Rome in the late 19th century - who later adapted his name to Bulgari in Italian.

articles.title: ‘You Can See Everything’ Crosses $100M Globally, Becomes First Doc to Hit 1M Letterboxd Watches
articles.summary: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's A24 documentary continues stirring conversation about Elizabeth Holmes through its sixth weekend in domestic release.
body: You Can See Everything continues visualizing box office success at a level that puts it in elite company as a documentary.

Over the weekend, You Can See Everything also became the first documentary film to have been watched by one million Letterboxd members. It becomes the 19th movie released in 2026 to join the “One Million Watched Club,” and with its 4.61 average Letterboxd rating, it is the second-highest-rated feature to hit the milestone, behind only 12 Angry Men with 4.63. You Can See Everything is the highest-rated 2026 film and the second-highest-rated documentary ever, trailing only Stop Making Sense on the social platform.

Among the box office achievements for You Can See Everything include opening with $15.6 million in its debut frame to register the second-biggest domestic launch for a non-music documentary, behind 2004’s Fahrenheit 9/11. The Holmes documentary also scored the highest-grossing domestic opening weekend for a release in fewer than 1,000 theaters since 2006’s Borat. You Can See Everything went on become the first documentary to reach No. 1 domestically in its third weekend of release.

articles.title: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in California ceremony
articles.summary: The couple have been together for four years and were engaged in 2025.
body: Miley Cyrus has married her partner of four years Maxx Morando during a ceremony in Palm Springs, California.
A string of black and white photos shared by the Flowers singer on Instagram showed the pair kissing while surrounded by white roses.

Her mother, Trisha Cyrus, and sister, Noah Cyrus, could be seen in the background of one image. Her father Billy Ray Cyrus was not in the picture but was at the ceremony with his partner, actress Liz Hurley.
Grammy-winning Cyrus, 33, wore a white silk dress designed by Anthony Vaccarello for Saint Laurent, while 28-year-old drummer Morando said "I do" in a black suit from the same fashion house.

articles.title: Delta Sets New Business Class Offerings With Collectible Missoni Kits, Wagyu Burgers and Blanton’s Bourbon on Board
articles.summary: The airline is heralding its new dining and hospitality offerings as the "next era of Delta One."
body: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.

Missoni pillows, a dark chocolate square and a pour of Blanton’s single-barrel bourbon isn’t just reserved for hotel turn-down service anymore — it’s also the new standard for Delta travelers flying in the airline’s Delta One cabin.

The U.S. airline unveiled its so-called “next era” of Delta One last month, with food and hospitality offerings that aim to position Delta as the “industry’s most premium end-to-end travel experience,” according to a release.

Dessert now includes the passenger-favorite ice cream cart, with the added option of a fruit sorbet paired with a splash of Taittinger Champagne. And the wines and spirits list has been fully updated with sommelier-approved bottles, including a Silver Oak Cabernet Sauvignon from Napa, which often retails for upwards of $200 in stores.

articles.title: 5 Best Performances In The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping, Ranked
articles.summary: From Joseph Zada's Haymitch Abernathy to Elle Fanning's Effie Trinket, here are the five best performances in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping.
body: It's a stacked cast and it's legitimately tough to choose, but ultimately, I've picked five performers who build upon the previous movies and performances from storied actors who defined these roles originally... and do so beautifully.

Fanning, a recently minted Oscar and Emmy nominee for her sensational projects "Sentimental Value" and "Margo's Got Money Troubles," is unsurprisingly great during her unfortunately limited screen time, particularly her delivery of Effie's most memorable line from the novel ("I confess to having a moment!"). Honestly, there are so many prequels possible in the wider Hunger Games world, and if Suzanne Collins ever wanted to a deep dive on Effie's whole "deal" and give her her own story, I wouldn't hate that. But she'd need to convince Fanning to return to really make the movie sing.

articles.title: Prime Video’s 5-Season Fantasy Series Doesn’t Have a Single Bad Season
articles.summary: It's been a tough decade for fans of fantasy television. Despite the early, world-shattering success of Game of Thrones and the prestige fantasy boom that followed, the last few years have seen a severe drop-off in quality for many promising projects.
body: Aside from expanding Grossman's world and honoring his characters, these additions are also what allow The Magicians to sustain its level of high quality across all five seasons. Although the series stretches its source material to more or less encompass its full run, the reality is that the show could have wrapped things up in at least three seasons if its creators had opted for a more straightforward adaptation. The reason The Magicians never experiences a sudden shift in quality or narrative drop-off is that the show's storytelling never becomes dependent on the books.

Unlike Game of Thrones, which found itself in serious trouble once the show caught up to George R.R. Martin 's series, The Magicians developed so many fresh takes on Quentin and his friends that it had plenty of additional material to explore, allowing The Magicians to come into its own over time rather than stray from the conventions of someone else's world.

articles.title: Josh Holloway Steals the 'Tracker' Show From Colter Shaw | Review
articles.summary: Tracker may have outdone itself this week by pairing Colter Shaw ( Justin Hartley ) with an unlikely ally who couldn't be more different from our hero on paper. body: Tracker works because the case changes every week and the four people solving it never do. Here is which of them you are, what it says about you, and the case for yours being the best of the four.

You would rather handle it yourself and you are usually capable of doing so. Colter is a survivalist who lives in an Airstream and takes reward money for finding missing people, which is a premise that only works because he is clearly running from something of his own.

You know somebody, and that somebody owes you a favour. Reenie is the lawyer Colter calls when a case needs a door opened legally, and she is the only person on the show who can get further with a phone call than he can on foot.

You are two steps ahead and you rarely mention it. Bobby is the one who finds the thing that unlocks the case, usually from a desk, usually about ninety seconds before anybody realises they needed it.
